title: MILO Marathon Dumaguete Leg 2026 Review: University-Town Qualifier
seo_title: MILO Marathon Dumaguete Leg 2026 Review | Philippines Race
meta_description: National MILO Marathon 2026 Dumaguete Leg: September 20. RUNRIO's series qualifier in the City of Gentle People.
dek: Set for 20 September 2026 in Dumaguete City, this RUNRIO-produced MILO Marathon qualifying leg brings the series to Negros Oriental's university town.
verdict: The MILO Marathon Dumaguete Leg is a RUNRIO-produced MILO series qualifier in Dumaguete City — Negros Oriental's charming university town, known for its Rizal Boulevard, its gentle pace of life, and its proximity to Apo Island's marine sanctuary. Five distances from 1K to 21K. RUNRIO's production ensures professional standards. September in Dumaguete is the tail of the wet season. A MILO series qualifier in one of the Philippines' most relaxed and liveable cities.
